name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-07-02, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
